newsitem.title: UK: BSkyB to launch digital satellite TV - FT.
newsitem.headline: BSkyB to launch digital satellite TV - FT.

text.p: British Sky Broadcasting Plc has decided to launch digital satellite television in the UK and plans to order one million decoders worth about 250 million pounds, the Financial Times reported.
The deal, due to be formally authorised by the BSkyB board on Tuesday, could see the arrival of up to 200 television channels in the UK by the end of the year, the FT said.
BSkyB has almost completed negotiations with four manufacturers on the supply of the decoders needed to receive the channels, the FT said.
The suppliers are believed to be Pace Micro Technology Plc, Panasonic, Sony and Nokia, said the newspaper.
